case.summary: Transaction 3626720 ($409.30) on card C06115-K1 was flagged due to a legacy real-time risk score of 0.69. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.008 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.63%. The in-person purchase in region 203 aligns directly with the holder's established regional history and baseline purchasing profile. Furthermore, the card has no association with any fraud rings and resides in a low-risk community with a fraud rate of 2.4%. The alert is determined to be a false alarm, and the transaction is cleared as legitimate cardholder activity.
